tool_args.rationale: Use the verified before/after normalized hysteresis form. The five observations vary step direction and horizon, with an equal-input case constraining the equilibrium coefficient; this removes the current parameter ambiguity without another paid probe.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The recalled mechanism is a three-parameter normalized contrast law, and five varied observations—including an equal-input row—provide enough constraints; current horizons also span the requested forecast horizon.
The opposing-step signature and dependence on both before and after inputs conflict with a stationary drift law based only on x_now and H.
It captures the step contrast but omits the verified normalized equal-input term supported by the equal-input observation.
